class.name: PolyMaterialND
class.brief_description: Polyhedral material for ND polyhedral meshes.
class.description: PolyMaterialND is a material for ND polyhedral meshes. The normal case is to use PolyMaterialND with a [PolyMeshND]-derived class, such as [ArrayPolyMeshND]. PolyMaterialND extends [CellMaterialND], providing interoperability in the same way that [PolyMeshND] extends [CellMeshND]. You can use a PolyMaterialND with a [CellMeshND], which will operate under the assumption that the simplex cells within the [CellMeshND] are grouped by their starting vertex in the same way that a [CellMeshND] generated from a [PolyMeshND] would be. You can also use a [CellMaterialND] with a [PolyMeshND], which would provide control over the individual simplexes that the cells get cut up into for rendering.

method.name: populate_albedo_color_array_for_poly_mesh
method.description: Populates the [member CellMaterialND.albedo_color_array] of this material for the given [param poly_mesh] by reading the cell colors from [member poly_albedo_color_array] and duplicating them for each simplex formed by the polyhedral cells. When a [PolyMeshND] is passed in directly, each simplex is mapped to its source polyhedral cell exactly using [method PolyMeshND.get_source_poly_cell_for_simplex_cell]. This function also supports any other [CellMeshND] which has its simplexes grouped by their starting vertex.

members.member: Array of albedo colors for the boundary cells in a polyhedral mesh. The length of this array should equal the boundary cell count of the mesh. See [method populate_albedo_color_array_for_poly_mesh] for details.
